caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental ironwork design composed of three vertical bars, each decorated with an intricate pattern of grapevines, grape clusters, and vine leaves. The three bars are spaced evenly apart and are interconnected at the top and bottom by horizontal bars, forming a rectangular framework. The grapevine motifs twist around each vertical bar, with grape clusters and lobed leaves arranged symmetrically along the vines. The color scheme is primarily shades of brown, suggesting the metallic texture and patina of wrought iron. The background is plain and light beige, providing contrast to the detailed darker ironwork in the foreground. The composition is centered within the image, and there is a small, neat inscription in the lower right corner that reads "ROSE-CAMPBELL GERKE."
title: Fence
